title: Generate authoritative projection-shape registry
description: Follow-up from eshyra-o9bd.19.5.1.8: when eshyra-o9bd.19.5.12 builds the clause-complete authoritative ledger, derive the closed projection-shape predicates and allowed schema/path registry from the authoritative corpus so bootstrap and authoritative absence proofs cannot drift. Preserve pack-wide scanning and fail-closed unknown-shape behavior.
acceptance_criteria: The authoritative ledger and bootstrap resolver share a generated or parity-checked closed schema/path registry, with cross-record and split-sibling regressions.
close_reason: ADR-0020 disposition pass 2026-09-22 (eshyra-o9bd.19 rebaseline): RETIRED - orphaned child of the DESIGN_INVALIDATED bootstrap ledger (eshyra-o9bd.19.5.1, PR #477 closed unmerged). It requires a positive semantic-absence proof, a closed projection-shape registry for absence proofs, the unmerged bootstrap-capability-roster-v1, or the pre-F1 obl::: identity, all of which rest on the global negative claim ADR 0020 withdrew. Replacement: none needed for the claim; bounded backlog reconciliation was delivered by eshyra-olc5.5 (PR #545) and the capability contract by eshyra-olc5.6. No importer or state defect is owned here.
